title: Staff
intro: Who works on TasksNearMe, and in which roles. Every change needs a reason and goes to the audit log.
rules: There must always be at least two admins, and nobody can remove their own admin role. Nobody grants themselves a role. With two or more admins, a new role waits for a second admin to approve it within 48 hours, and every admin is emailed when a role takes effect.
emailHint: The email of an existing account.
reasonHint: 10 to 1,000 characters. It's kept in the audit log.
sent: Sent for approval. It takes effect once another admin approves it, within 48 hours.

errors.roleInUse: They already have this role, or a grant of it is waiting for approval.
errors.reasonRequired: Enter a reason of at least 10 characters.
errors.notAllowed: That change isn't possible now. Refresh the page to see the current roles.

caption: Staff members and their roles
removeDescription: {name} loses the {role} role at once. Their account stays as it is.

authenticator.none: Authenticator app: not set up yet
authenticator.pending: Authenticator app: added, waiting for its first code
authenticator.codeHint: Tell them in person or by phone, never by email. It works once, until {time}, and replaces any earlier code.
authenticator.resetDescription: {name}'s authenticator app stops working and they're asked for a code again everywhere they're signed in. Give them a new setup code afterwards.
authenticator.resetDone: Authenticator reset. Give them a new setup code.
authenticator.failed: That didn't work. Refresh the page and try again.

pending.title: Waiting for a second admin
pending.intro: A new role takes effect once another admin approves it. Requests end after 48 hours.
pending.waiting: Another admin decides this one: you asked for it, or it's for you.
pending.approved: Approved: the role is theirs now, and every admin has been emailed.

errors.expired: This request ended after 48 hours. Ask again if it's still needed.
errors.conflict: Another admin decided this request first. Refresh the page to see it.
errors.notAllowed: You asked for this grant, or it's for you: another admin decides it.
